staticMethods.description: Displays a temporary notification from your component. Returns the notification's UUID, which you can use to dismiss it or update its progress.
staticMethods.name: show

params.description: The message to display in the notification.
params.name: message

params.description: The type of notification, which determines its styling and icon. Use "indeterminate" to show an animated progress bar while work of unknown length runs, or "progress" to show a progress bar you update with setProgress(). Defaults to "basic".
params.name: options.type

params.description: How long the notification stays before it auto-dismisses: "short" (about 3 seconds), "medium" (about 4 seconds), "long" (about 6 seconds), or a number of milliseconds. Only "basic", "success", and "failure" notifications auto-dismiss (default "short"). "indeterminate" and "progress" notifications have no default duration and stay until you dismiss them.
params.name: options.duration

params.description: Text for an action button. When set, the notification shows a button the user can select.
params.name: options.actionText

params.description: Function to run when the action button is selected.
params.name: options.action

params.description: UUID of an existing notification to cancel when this one is shown.
params.name: options.cancelUUID

staticMethods.description: Hides a notification, using the UUID that show() returns.
staticMethods.name: dismiss

params.description: The UUID of the notification to dismiss. This is the value that show() returns.
params.name: uuid

staticMethods.description: Updates the progress shown on a progress notification, using the UUID that show() returns.
staticMethods.name: setProgress

params.description: The UUID of the progress notification to update. This is the value that show() returns.
params.name: uuid

params.description: The progress to display, from 0 to 100.
params.name: progress
